consequence.statement: The metric is no longer emitted; dashboards or alerts relying on it will have no data.

original.statement: The metric cilium_cidrgroup_translation_time_stats_seconds has been removed because the measured code path no longer exists.

decision.reason: [ev-f3d0a6f12b97] says only that the metric `cilium_cidrgroup_translation_time_stats_seconds` was removed because the code path it measured no longer exists. It does not say that anything fails, is rejected or must be migrated, so a mandatory-work kind would over-claim. If the metric is no longer emitted, dashboards or alerts that use it get no data, which is worth a review. That fits behavior-change at low severity, with the class review-required.
